name: Eros Strobel
original_name: エロース＝ストローベル
source:
Wizard student from distinguished family. She is proud of her family reputation but the truth is she can't use magic at all. She treats the protagonist crudely but relies on him at the same time as he is her salvation from this hopeless situation.

Magic type: Wind
